description:
## Empirical anchor

Arc 40 VERA verdict surfaces (methodology_concerns m1 + m2, 2026-05-18 Phase 3) — TWO probe-spec defects in agents/design/arc-40/design.md that match the exact defect class the arc just shipped at CAPTAIN_VERA.md §5.11 (probe-spec regex anchoring + grounded-against-shipped-code discipline). Per CLAUDE.md global Fix-now + the design's own §7.1a/§8.4 self-application teaching note: file as concrete-plan ticket for next available arc.

## Defect 1 (VERA m1, also noted by ADA at Phase 2 close)

Design probes p15/p18 cite install.sh flags that do NOT exist in the shipped script:
- `--no-bw-init` — not a real flag
- `--dest <path>` — not a real flag

The correct invocation pattern is `--target <project|subproject|user> --project-dir <path>` (project-dir must pre-exist; install.sh does not auto-create).

VERA verified the underlying properties PASS via translated commands; the literal probe spec would have FAILED on a less-experienced verifier. Defect class: probe-spec authoring drifted from shipped code at design-time (the exact failure mode the §5.2 grounding-check preamble + VERA §5.11 anchoring discipline catch).

## Defect 2 (VERA m2)

Design probe p24 greps `^Status:.*closed` against `bw show <id>` output. bw does NOT emit a literal "Status:" line — bw show uses a ✓ glyph in the header (e.g., `# ✓ stoa--utn — ...`) to indicate closed state. The literal grep always returns 0 (no match) regardless of actual ticket state — probe is structurally broken, not just under-specified.

Defect class: probe-spec assumed an output shape that doesn't match the tool's actual emit. Same family as defect 1 (ground-check drift).

## Why not fixed in Arc 40

Same reasoning as Arc 39 stoa--t9u: bundling design.md probe-spec fixes into the build commits would mix scopes mid-arc-close. Design.md is intermediate working artifact; fixing post-merge as a small housekeeping commit is the cleaner shape. Per CLAUDE.md global Fix-now legitimate-defer #2.

## Concrete next-step plan

1. **Re-author the 3 affected probes (p15, p18, p24) in agents/design/arc-40/design.md** to ground-check against shipped tools:
   - p15/p18: use `--target <tier> --project-dir <pre-existing-path>` shape (replace --no-bw-init / --dest)
   - p24: use `bw show <id> | head -1 | grep -E '^# [✓]'` OR `bw list --closed | grep <id>` shape (anchor against actual bw output convention)

2. **Add a probe-self-application checklist** to design.md §4 (or new §4.0): before submitting any design.md probe, the author runs every probe command literally as a sanity-check; failures surface immediately. Make the existing §8.4 audit-of-surviving-probes rule explicit + load-bearing at authoring time.

3. **Apply §5.11 (VERA seat-canon shipped Arc 40) at design-authoring time**: every probe regex must be anchored OR explicit-substring-OK with rationale; ARGUS/CATO screens during cold-audit.

4. **Bundle into next available arc OR housekeeping commit** (DAEDALUS picks at design time):
   - (α) Small-scope housekeeping commit direct to main (user-tier POLYBIUS §18 lane: arc-build artifact cleanup) — defensible because design.md is the arc's working artifact, not shipped canon
   - (β) Fold into next arc (Arc 41 candidate) — keeps all design.md edits behind PR review
   - PLINY-lean: (α) housekeeping — design.md is past its review window; CATO already cleared the build, not the probe-spec quality

## Out of scope

- Refactoring all 21 surviving Arc 40 probes (only 3 affected per VERA verdict)
- Adding probe-self-application discipline to substrate canon at op-disc layer (VERA §5.11 lift to universal-team layer is a sp1-style follow-up)
- Modifying VERA §5.11 prose (just shipped; let it accumulate evidence)

## Cross-references

- Arc 40 VERA verdict: agents/verdicts/arc-40/CAPTAIN_VERA-2026-05-18T07-02-09Z.md (methodology_concerns m1+m2)
- Arc 40 ADA Phase 2 verdict notes same m1 drift
- Arc 40 design.md §7.1a + §8.4 (self-application teaching note shipped this arc)
- substrate/CAPTAIN_VERA.md §5.11 (the canon this defect class violates)
- substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md §5.2 (the grounding-check preamble that catches this at ADA build time)
- stoa--t9u (Arc 39 follow-up of same class — install.sh pycache deploy exclusion; folded into Arc 40)

## Sequencing

P3. Next-arc candidate OR housekeeping commit. Fix-now-with-concrete-plan per CLAUDE.md. Not blocking Arc 41 substrate work.
